notes.title: Thrift Shop Demo Playthrough
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44364063/4b886f08e63e0ebc73aa2a969d9088a78b49a959.png[/img]

[h1]Let's go thrift shopping together![/h1]

Join me as I play through the demo of my new game, [b]Thrift Shop[/b]. You can follow along while I learn from my mentor, Papa Pinchpenny, and go on quests. I'll visit thrift shops to buy items, then use my workshop to clean, repair, scrap and appraise them before selling.

Excited to hear your questions and get feedback on ways to make the game even more fun before release. 

[b]Thank you![/b]
[i]-Steve[/i]
